testName: Opportunity Splits & Sales Team Revenue Allocation
steps:
1. Open Opportunities tab
2. Open recent Opportunity record with Amount $100,000
3. Scroll to Opportunity Team related list and click "Add Opportunity Team Members"
4. Add Sales Engineer "Alex Morgan" with Role "Technical Specialist" and Read/Write access
5. Click on Save
6. Click on "Edit Opportunity Splits" in Opportunity Splits related list
7. Assign Primary Owner 70% ($70,000) and Sales Engineer 30% ($30,000)
8. Click on Save button
9. Verify total split percentage equals exactly 100% and forecasts reflect updated quota attribution
